title: Emei releases Night at the Opera: Intermission with new single
summary: Basking in the spotlight of a breakout year, Chinese-American alternative pop singer/songwriter Emei uncovers her anxiously awaited new 2-pack ‘Night At The Opera: Intermission’ out now…

blocks.text: Basking in the spotlight of a breakout year, Chinese-American alternative pop singer/songwriter Emei uncovers her anxiously awaited new 2-pack ‘Night At The Opera: Intermission’ out now via Atlantic Records in partnership with multi-GRAMMY® Award-winning mega-producer Ricky Reed’s Nice Life. Fans can listen to the 2-pack HERE. The release features Emei’s bombastic and blunt new single, “Regularly Scheduled Program”. Building anticipation for its release, Emei previewed the track on tour, where it was met with an enthusiastic response from fans.
